content.about: Gabon sits on the equator on Africa's Atlantic coast, and nearly nine-tenths of it is rainforest. It protects a large share of its land as national parks. Forest elephants, gorillas and leopards live in its forests. Its capital is Libreville.

standout.text: Gabon's Loango National Park is known for elephants, hippos and buffalo walking on the beach.

didYouKnow: Hippos sometimes swim in the sea off Loango.
The Oklo natural nuclear reactors formed in Gabon about 2 billion years ago.
